speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: I'd like to talk about children. What was life like for you growing up? Did you have to worry about your basic needs at all? Like food, place to live, safety, etc?

speaker: A3C46LJ7P8YIO0
text: There were periods in my childhood when money was very short and we had our telephone or power cut off, but I always had a safe place to live and food to eat.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: It is really difficult having to grow up having to worry about basic needs. I'm glad you are able to look for what to be grateful for.

speaker: A3C46LJ7P8YIO0
text: What was life like for you growing up?  Did you have any worries about food, shelter, safety, etc.?

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: I guess there are more people than we know who grew up with no worries. I grew up worrying about my safety and whether I'd have a place to live. My dad was a gambling addict.

speaker: A3C46LJ7P8YIO0
text: I don't have any experiences like that but I'm sure it must have been very difficult and scary to go through that as a child.

speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: Thank you. I really appreciate your sympathizing, and I'm glad I got to share that with someone.

speaker: A3C46LJ7P8YIO0
text: Did you ever use the services of any organizations for children to help you through the rough times?

If I make donations now, they are in-kind donations rather than monetary donations.  What organizations do you donate to?  I tend to make donations to a emergency children's shelter.
